name: Page Not Found Redirect
description: Provides a configurable, friendly 404 page with an admin-managed title, message and link buttons, plus a broken-URL logger.
project_description:
Page Not Found Redirect is a lightweight Drupal module that automatically redirects users to a meaningful page when they visit a non-existent URL (404 error) or an unavailable node.

 Instead of displaying Drupal's default "Page not found" message, this module improves the user experience by guiding visitors to a predefined destination.

 Features 
 
 Redirects all 404 (Page Not Found) requests 
 Redirects invalid or deleted node URLs 
 Configurable redirect destination 
 Supports Drupal 10 and Drupal 11 
 Lightweight and performance-friendly
